about: The console's Ask eval (hack/simlab/ask_eval.py): questions from the week's analyses, each with the SQL that answers it over the catalog and the checks its answer must pass. A check is {text} (the answer names it), {number, tol} (the answer gives a number within tol of it, relative), {any: [texts]} (the answer says one of them) or {none: [texts]} (it says none of them); check mode finds every text and number among the reference SQL's values.

questions.question: Which cells are structural in experiment sa0755?
reference_sql: SELECT cell, arms, runs FROM structural('sa0755') ORDER BY cell
questions.answer: seed-restart and seed-starved: every run of both arms (aimd, main) collapses there, 64 runs each.

questions.question: How many of sa0755's main arm's collapsed runs fall in structural cells?
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.collapsed) AS collapsed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.collapsed AND e.cell IN (SELECT cell FROM structural('sa0755'))) AS structural FROM experiment_jobs e JOIN verdicts v USING (k, src) WHERE e.exp_id = 'sa0755' AND e.arm_label = 'main'
questions.answer: 64 of its 71 collapsed runs, all in seed-starved and seed-restart; 7 collapse elsewhere.

questions.question: In sa0755, which seeds collapsed in star-15-10-end-abrupt in each arm, and is the difference between the arms significant?
reference_sql: SELECT e.arm_label, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.collapsed) AS collapsed, count(*) AS runs, list(e.seed ORDER BY e.seed) FILTER (WHERE v.collapsed) AS seeds FROM experiment_jobs e JOIN verdicts v USING (k, src) WHERE e.exp_id = 'sa0755' AND e.cell = 'star-15-10-end-abrupt' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
SELECT ka, kb, n, round(p, 2) AS p FROM collapse_test('sa0755', 'main', 'sa0755', 'aimd') WHERE cell = 'star-15-10-end-abrupt'

questions.question: What is the absolute lag p99 (the geomean over cells, structural cells left out) of sa0755's main arm, of s7ae7e (trains-seed) and of s01a51's ytf arm?
reference_sql: WITH runs AS (SELECT e.exp_id, e.arm_label, e.cell, w.lag_p99_ms, v.collapsed FROM experiment_jobs e JOIN rows w USING (k, src) JOIN verdicts v USING (k, src) WHERE (e.exp_id, e.arm_label) IN (('sa0755', 'main'), ('s7ae7e', 'trains-seed'), ('s01a51', 'ytf'))), st AS (SELECT exp_id, cell FROM experiment_jobs e JOIN verdicts v USING (k, src) WHERE e.exp_id IN ('sa0755', 's7ae7e', 's01a51') GROUP BY ALL HAVING bool_and(v.collapsed)), per_cell AS (SELECT r.exp_id, r.arm_label, r.cell, exp(avg(ln(r.lag_p99_ms)) FILTER (WHERE r.lag_p99_ms > 0)) AS geo FROM runs r ANTI JOIN st USING (exp_id, cell) GROUP BY ALL) SELECT exp_id, arm_label, round(exp(avg(ln(geo))), 1) AS lag_p99_ms FROM per_cell GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
questions.answer: sa0755:main 439 ms, s7ae7e:trains-seed 360 ms, s01a51:ytf 381 ms (43 cells each, seed-starved and seed-restart left out).

questions.question: Does sa0755's aimd arm collapse more than main? Is the difference significant in any cell?
reference_sql: SELECT collapsed, base_collapsed, round(p99, 3) AS p99 FROM arm_score('sa0755', 'main', 'sa0755', 'aimd')
SELECT cell, ka, kb, round(p, 2) AS p FROM collapse_test('sa0755', 'main', 'sa0755', 'aimd') WHERE ka <> kb ORDER BY p, cell
questions.answer: aimd collapses 78 runs to main's 71 (14 to 7 outside the structural cells), but no cell's difference is significant: the largest is star-15-10-end-abrupt (10 vs 5, Fisher p = 0.24).

questions.question: What is aimd's geomean lag p99 ratio against main in sa0755, and its wire bytes per useful byte ratio?
reference_sql: SELECT round(p99, 4) AS p99, round(wire, 4) AS wire FROM arm_score('sa0755', 'main', 'sa0755', 'aimd')
questions.answer: x1.016 lag p99, x1.000 wire per useful byte.

questions.question: Is the lag tail of star-31-5 in sa0755's main arm a startup tail or steady-state spikes?
reference_sql: SELECT round(lag_p99_startup_ms) AS startup, round(lag_p99_steady_ms) AS steady, spike_s_1250, collapsed FROM dynamics('sa0755') WHERE arm_label = 'main' AND cell = 'star-31-5'
questions.answer: A startup tail: its lag p99 is 5567 ms over startup against 563 ms in steady state, with no second per run past 1250 ms after startup.

questions.question: And star-15-10-end-abrupt in sa0755's main arm: is its lag tail startup, steady state or after its viewers' departures?
reference_sql: SELECT phase, viewer_s, round(share, 3) AS share, round(lag_p99_ms) AS lag_p99_ms FROM dynamics_phases('sa0755') WHERE arm_label = 'main' AND cell = 'star-15-10-end-abrupt' ORDER BY lag_p99_ms DESC
questions.answer: After the departures: lag p99 3442 ms in after_departure (the 45 s after each abrupt departure, 46 % of its viewer-seconds) against 453 ms over startup and 372 ms in steady state.

questions.question: Outside the structural cells, which cell of sa0755's main arm spends the most seconds per run lagging past the 1250 ms playout delay after startup?
reference_sql: SELECT cell, spike_s_1250, spike_s_4250 FROM dynamics('sa0755') WHERE arm_label = 'main' AND cell NOT IN (SELECT cell FROM structural('sa0755')) ORDER BY spike_s_1250 DESC LIMIT 3
questions.answer: wan-slow-viewer: 35 s per run past 1250 ms (and past 4250 ms), far ahead of wan-residential-seed-step at 8.0 s.

questions.question: In s4c249's star-31-5 cell, how many kbit/s do the viewers spend on HAVEs and on requests, in the decl arm (no HAVEs) and in main?
reference_sql: WITH runs AS (SELECT arm_label AS arm, k, src FROM experiment_jobs WHERE exp_id = 's4c249' AND cell = 'star-31-5'), per_job AS (SELECT r.arm, (max(b.t_ms) - min(b.t_ms)) / 1000.0 AS secs, sum(b.viewer_have_bytes) AS have, sum(b.viewer_request_bytes) AS request FROM runs r JOIN bins b USING (k, src) GROUP BY r.arm, r.k) SELECT arm, round(sum(have) * 8 / 1000 / sum(secs), 1) AS have_kbps, round(sum(request) * 8 / 1000 / sum(secs), 1) AS request_kbps FROM per_job GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
questions.answer: decl: no HAVEs (0 kbit/s), 389 kbit/s of requests; main: 673 kbit/s of HAVEs and 16 kbit/s of requests.

questions.question: What did s8ed1e compare: which arms, how many cells and how many seeds per cell?
reference_sql: SELECT arm_label, count(DISTINCT cell) AS cells, count(DISTINCT seed) AS seeds, min(seed) AS first_seed, max(seed) AS last_seed FROM experiment_jobs WHERE exp_id = 's8ed1e' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
questions.answer: p4tf against vouch on the robust tier: 45 cells, 32 seeds each (2001-2032).

questions.question: Outside the structural cells, where does s7ae7e's trains-seed arm collapse? List the cells and how many runs collapsed in each.
reference_sql: SELECT e.cell, count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.collapsed) AS collapsed, count(*) AS runs FROM experiment_jobs e JOIN verdicts v USING (k, src) WHERE e.exp_id = 's7ae7e' AND e.cell NOT IN (SELECT cell FROM structural('s7ae7e')) GROUP BY ALL HAVING collapsed > 0 ORDER BY collapsed DESC, cell
questions.answer: 16 runs in 5 cells: star-15-10-end-abrupt 11 of 32, halve-31-10 2, and one each in wan-residential-seed-step, wan-slow-viewer and wan-super-peer-varying.
